era: Indeed.com 2019 (Arquivo.pt captures of job search result pages Mar and Sep 2019 and job pages Sep-Oct 2019): top links Find Jobs / Company Reviews / Find Salaries, Upload your resume, Sign in and Employers / Post Job; the Indeed logo with the What ('job title, keywords, or company') and Where ('city, state, or zip code') fields and the Find Jobs button; result pages with the 'X jobs in Y' heading, filters, result cards with save job and pagination; job pages with Apply Now, save and report job; the footer with Hiring Lab, Career Advice, Browse Jobs, Browse Companies, Salaries, Employer Events, Work at Indeed, Countries, About, Help Center and 'Cookies, Privacy and Terms'. No 2019 capture of the bare home page exists on Arquivo.pt (Indeed redirected crawlers), so the home page's header, search form and footer are backed by the same elements on the 2019 result and job pages. The live site is behind Cloudflare, so the inventory was taken read-only in the user's Chrome with the inventory collector.
